'''Doli-bur Barc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]], bearded [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] representing his constituents in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] politician, Doli-bur Barc served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] around [[3643 BBY]] following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the resurgence of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Part of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]-era Senate, Barc represented the interests of his constituents by serving on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], having offices in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. After careful analysis of the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial military]], Senator Barc began to believe that the use of [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] could be the key to beating the Sith and returning the Republic to dominance. Purchasing an entire shipment of [[Ryloth/Legends|Rylothian]] [[Rylothian slave collar|slave collars]], Barc intended to use the collars in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] to bolster the Republic's numbers.<ref name="SWTORTSSG" />

{{GameLSmechanics}}
As Barc's shipment arrived on Coruscant members of the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]] hijacked the shipment and they were dispersed among the Guild's members in the [[Old Galactic Market]]. Displeased by the hijacking, Senator Barc ordered the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to locate the shipment and return it to his office. When [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Denal-zon]]'s men were bogged down on the Galactic Market concourse, a representative of the Senator named [[Heerimus]] tipped off another individual to track down the shipment and return it. While the independent individual did collect the slave collars, Captain Denal-zon caught up to them and was able to convince the individual to bring the illegal chips to him for destruction.<ref name="SWTORTSSG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Doli-bur Barc appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' Coruscant quest called "The Senator's Stolen Goods". The player can also choose to return the shipment of collars to the Senator, or to talk to the Senator and tell him that the chips must be destroyed before taking them to Captain Denal-zon. This article assumes that the player made the light side choice and did not speak to Senator Barc at all.

Barc appears in the "Signs of War" trailer released on [[October 14]], [[2011]], where a clip of a player giving Barc his son's journal is shown. However, [[Satele Shan]]'s narration of the scene describes it as "corruption on Coruscant," despite it being nothing of the sort.
